questions.question: What interests you about working on Salesforce Industries Communications Cloud and telecom Quote-to-Cash solutions?
Your background includes Cisco networking training and computer support. How have those experiences prepared you to understand technical systems, integrations, and customer technology environments?
Describe a time you had to learn a new technical tool, process, or system quickly. How did you approach the learning process?
This role involves designing solutions that use Salesforce APIs and third-party APIs. What is your current understanding of APIs, and how would you go about troubleshooting an integration issue?
How would you explain a technical system limitation or implementation trade-off to a nontechnical business stakeholder?
Describe an experience where accuracy was especially important in your data-entry work. What steps did you take to validate information before completing the work?

This position requires documenting solution designs and reviewing implementation work. What methods would you use to keep technical documentation clear, organized, and useful for both onsite and offshore team members?

In your kitchen roles, you progressed from dishwasher to preparation and line-cook responsibilities. What did that progression teach you about working in a fast-paced team environment and taking on increasing responsibility?
How would you organize and prioritize work when supporting a project with multiple tasks, changing requirements, and deadlines?
What experience or coursework have you had with source control, software deployments, networking, or computer support, and which areas are you most interested in developing further?
